title: Specify the actual coherent port and forward receiver
statement: Two sequential passive receiving qubits act on a coherent traveling field while retaining the fixed source marginal.

evidence.quote: ## 1. The source and the actual receiver

requires: One source qubit with FIXED H_S=Omega X/2,L_S=sqrt(gamma)Z,Omega>0,gamma>0,and Markov equation -i[H_S,rho]+gamma D[Z]rho. Coherent traveling measurement field BEFORE irreversible amplification,vacuum input;collection fraction0<eta<=1 reaches Bob,rest inaccessible. A reduced dephasing master equation alone does not supply this coherent interface. Two cold receiving qubits start00;R_j=sqrt(kappa)sigma_minus_j withkappa=Omega,active successively on[0,h] and[h,2h],h=pi/(2Omega),T=pi/Omega;inactive receiver stores state. Standard forward cascade preserves the prescribed source marginal,not an added direct source-receiver gate. Calibrated phases/couplings,accurate local filters/gates/storage and optional downstream photon-counter no-click flag with0<=zeta<=1 are explicit ideal-model premises. Original source is discarded WITHOUT measurement. Input is arbitrary unknown S,possibly entangled with inaccessible referenceA;filter requiresu<=1.
provides: With C=sqrt(eta gamma)Z_S and activeR_j,the joint generator is -i[H_S+(R_j^dagger C-C^dagger R_j)/(2i),rho]+D[C+R_j]rho+(1-eta)gamma D[Z_S]rho. The cross Hamiltonian is standard cascaded input-output interaction,not an additional programmable source-receiver gate.

Receiver1 couples during[0,h],receiver2 during[h,2h],kappa=Omega;the inactive qubit stores coherence. Bob then uses local flag filters and a two-qubit unitary,optionally monitoring output AFTER receivers. No direct carrier measurement/retention or global radiation-field unitary is assumed.

A coherent pure traveling measurement output before irreversible amplification is a real premise. The same reduced dephasing equation can have a different accessible classical/mixed implementation;it does not deliver this interface by itself. Accurate cold initialization,phases/couplings/local operations/storage are also premises,with physical costs unresolved.
assumptions: The source reports a completed ideal MARKOV successful instrument for this specific generator/interface,not a competitive finite-bandwidth device. Coherent field access before amplification,vacuum/cold initialization,collection/detection efficiencies,calibrated phases/couplings/local operations and coherent storage remain physical requirements. Collection loss is inaccessible,not measured for heralding. A failed attempt can CONSUME the unknown input;repeating cannot recover that same state. Do not equate single-use success/error with an asymptotic capacity,repeat-until-success transmission or fault tolerance. No receiver minimality/optimality is proved;source working history mentions a shaped one-receiver alternative without making it the final theorem. Joint finite-bandwidth instrument approximation,success-scaled error,overheads,efficiency curve and platform advantage remain OPEN. Established coherent-measurement and continuous-decoder bridges are credited. Finite numeric/constant checks are SOURCE-REPORTED;linked files not acquired,no new Capital/root reproof/audit/prior-art check or external gate. No new measured hardware,novelty/priority or general arbitrary-generator receiver capability is established.
